subject: vt-dy
title: (R)VT.DY.------V.SY.
description: Chart on book p. 354 (PMBA-18). VT-DY (vibrational dynamics) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; V-SY (value system) is the partner. From the subject: COS-P (cosmic particulars), POL-DY (political dynamics) and TR (transformation). From COS-P: T-C-IMP (time continuum implications). From POL-DY: IF-ST-DY (infra-structure dynamics). From IF-ST-DY: INFO-DE-B (information degrees). From TR: AFI (affinity insight) and EXPM (expansionism). From EXPM: MOT-DY. The label IST-S-ALGN (isolated systematic alignment) is drawn below the POL-DY dot with no dot or line of its own.
